| **Likelihood** | plausible — Exposed roles such as customer service are already shrinking while AI-related roles grow, and a one-point rise in unemployment over a decade is within past experience of technological churn. |
| **Assessed** | 2026-11-27 |

The same faster growth and top-heavy gains, plus rolling job losses across occupations: unemployment ends a point higher and participation a point lower, about 3 million people at any time. Displaced workers suffer lasting earnings and health losses.

## Social contract scores (draft)

| Promise | Score | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hard work pays | 2 | About 3 million displaced workers at any time suffer lasting earnings losses and move to lower-paying occupations or out of the labour force, while gains go to the top quintile. |
| Affordable essentials |  | Not addressed: the extract says nothing on the cost of housing, food, energy or care in this scenario. |
| Reliable safety net | 2 | Unemployment insurance pays about half of wages for 26 weeks, misses gig and informal workers and is too short for occupational change, and TAA has lapsed. |
| Responsive government | 3 | Losses spread nationwide lower the risk of regional spirals in local public finances and the federal budget still improves, though the authors warn policy may respond late as after the China shock. |
| Time for what matters |  | Not addressed: the extract covers health harms of job loss but nothing on time for family, community or meaning. |
